• ### Flag

  Use one value, -deprecatedrpc=watchonly, for the six RPCs. With it, accept their legacy positional signatures. Without it, reject those signatures with a deprecation error. The new options forms work either way.

  ### RPC arguments

   RPC                      Legacy positional arguments, in order                                                           New form
  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  ───────────────────────  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   listreceivedbyaddress    minconf, include_empty, include_watchonly, address_filter?, include_immature_coinbase           options={minconf, include_empty, address_filter, include_immature_coinbase}
  ───────────────────────  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   listreceivedbylabel      minconf, include_empty, include_watchonly, include_immature_coinbase                            options={minconf, include_empty, include_immature_coinbase}
  ───────────────────────  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   listtransactions         label?, count, skip, include_watchonly                                                          label?, options={count, skip}
  ───────────────────────  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

   gettransaction           txid, include_watchonly, verbose                                                                txid, options={verbose}

  ### Proposed parsing approach

  Keep OBJ_NAMED_PARAMS for the new options, with skip_type_check on the options argument so the positional parser can also receive the old scalar at that position. Add optional trailing legacy slots so the RPC’s fixed
  argument-count check accepts old calls. In each RPC, distinguish an options object from a legacy scalar; gate the legacy path with rpcEnableDeprecated("watchonly"), validate its old arguments, ignore include_watchonly, and
  use the remaining values in their old positions.

  Named parameters should still be collected into the options object by OBJ_NAMED_PARAMS. Deprecated named fields such as include_watchonly would need to remain in metadata for conversion and be gated in the handler. The
  hidden legacy slots need care because the current named-argument mapping also sees hidden arguments; this approach is a sketch that would need a focused implementation check.
